status: Fresh data and packages verified; headless closed-loop retry awaiting idle GPU

phases.title: Source & protocol
phases.detail: Pinned upstream commit, nested dependencies and official checksums for all 12 data assets. Official training arguments captured directly.

phases.title: H800 environments
phases.detail: Both isolated installations complete. Policy CPU suite: 103 tests passed; world: 24 tests with two retained skips. Both compiled CUDA bundles and actual headless RGB/depth capture plus graceful shutdown passed. Numerical equivalence to the original Docker stack remains unvalidated.

phases.title: Release data
phases.detail: Ten of twelve assets passed official SHA-256 acceptance and safe extraction. Training-WM part 1 is installed; part 2 is downloading and part 3 follows. All 640 held-out test episodes are indexed. Partial bytes are not accepted assets.

phases.title: GPU acceptance
phases.detail: Both CUDA/camera bundles passed. Actual WM init/update/10-frame prediction and released PhysMani/3DFA WebSocket finite 8D inference passed. The first closed-loop attempt was blocked by a simulator informational modal and produced no valid episode. A reviewed headless retry retains warnings/errors and awaits ten idle GPU samples.

phases.title: Self collection
phases.detail: All 16 tasks reached two accepted scripted-expert successes, total 32. Across 68 attempt slots, 33 successes were recorded; unused attempts and one infrastructure failure remain preserved. These are expert data, not policy success rates.

phases.title: Fresh WM & packaging
phases.detail: All 32 four-view WM generations and visualizations completed with original budgets. The encoded-depth format adapter passed 384 byte-for-byte comparisons and the original Dataset produced a finite 32-episode batch with four cameras, WM velocity clouds and 8D actions. Failed partial outputs remain preserved.

phases.title: Full training
phases.detail: Full development-host controller queued behind environment, data and smoke gates. Stage 1, PhysMani Stage 2 and 3DFA: 100,000 updates each, seed 0, three idle cards, batch 18 per card.

phases.title: Policy evaluation
phases.detail: A new headless controller verified and reused the completed collection, WM and 384-check package receipts. It is awaiting idle GPU utilization for the released 3DFA single-episode smoke, then PhysMani. The stopped modal-blocked attempt counts no episode. All 12,800 formal episodes remain pending.

phases.title: World-model quality
phases.detail: 640 held-out trajectories; horizons 1/5/10 at 0.05 s per frame. PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS and depth log RMSE. Object-center error requires verified GT.

blockers: Full reproduction is unfinished. Remaining train-WM inputs and three measured batch-18/200-update smokes must pass before formal training. No formal model success rate has been produced.
